other.summary: Non-GET/HEAD requests now do filesystem lookups, so PermissionError gives 401 and other OSErrors give 500 instead of the old unconditional 405
other.reason: The diff makes the non-GET branch call _lookup_static_resource → _lookup_path, which maps PermissionError to 401 and re-raises other OSErrors. Starlette's lookup_path only catches FileNotFoundError and NotADirectoryError, so e.g. ELOOP gives a 500. Before the PR, 405 was raised without touching the filesystem. Real and reachable, but very low impact and consistent with GET. The line number 1843 is right.

Style point. The two calls are in mutually exclusive branches and there is no functional problem.
